enable_index.description: Enable the use of MySQL to store the Orthanc index

enable_storage.description: Enable the use of MySQL to store the DICOM files

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the MySQL server

port.description: The port number of the MySQL server

database.description: The name of the MySQL database

username.description: The username to connect to the MySQL database

unix_socket.description: The path to the MySQL unix socket

password.description: The password to connect to the MySQL database

lock.description: Whether to enable the locking of the MySQL database

enable_ssl.description: Whether to connect to MySQL using SSL

maximum_connection_retries.description: Number of retries when connecting to MySQL

connection_retry_interval.description: Number of seconds between two attempts when opening a connection to MySQL

index_connections_count.description: Number of connections to MySQL in the connection pool of the index back-end
